deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (domestic and international); no spring entry.
deadline.quote: Applications must be completed by the December 1, 2026 deadline (for both domestic and international students) to be considered for admission in the fall.

gre_subject.value: No GRE (general or biology subject) is required.
gre_subject.quote: What about GREs? Is the subject test in biology required? | The GRE is no longer required.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; you may mention scores in your essay.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required. | However, the program does not require this information for admission.

supervisor.value: No faculty contact is needed before applying; students match with labs at recruitment events (BEES/PSYS) or through rotations (CBBG/MOCB).
supervisor.quote: you are not required to have been in touch with any faculty members prior to applying. | For accepted students, matching will happen during our recruitment events (BEES/PSYS) or during laboratory rotations (CBBG/MOCB).

funding.value: Support comes from fellowships, RA or TA posts with stipend, tuition and health insurance; historically all students have been funded.
funding.quote: Historically, all students have been supported throughout their graduate careers.

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a bachelor's; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: We accept students directly into the Ph.D. program, whether or not they have already earned a master’s degree.

fee_waiver.value: The program does not grant fee waivers to international applicants; you can ask a prospective PI, who may choose to cover it.
fee_waiver.quote: Our program DOES NOT grant fee waivers to international applicants due to university-wide policies currently in effect.

notes: Concentrations: BEES, CBBG, MOCB and PSYS. BISI does not take applicants who need provisional intensive-English admission.
name: Biological Sciences (BISI)
